webhooks.confirm.deleteBody: Services using its URL can no longer post. Messages it already posted stay in the channel.
webhooks.confirm.rotateBody: The current URL stops working immediately. Update every service that posts with it.
webhooks.disabledNotice: {name} is disabled: posts to its URL are refused until you enable it again.
webhooks.empty: No webhooks in this channel yet.
webhooks.error.forbidden: You need the Manage Channels permission to change webhooks.
webhooks.error.invalidChannel: Webhooks can only post in text channels.
webhooks.error.invalidName: Give the webhook a name of 1 to {max} characters.
webhooks.error.limit: A channel can have at most {count, plural, one {# webhook} other {# webhooks}}.
webhooks.error.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection.
webhooks.error.notFound: This webhook or channel no longer exists. Reload the page.
webhooks.error.rateLimited: Too many changes at once. Wait a moment and try again.
webhooks.error.signIn: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
webhooks.intro: Let an outside service, like a build server or a form, post into #{channel}. Anyone who has a webhook's URL can post with it, so keep it secret like a password.
webhooks.reveal.body: Services post to the channel by sending JSON to this URL.
webhooks.reveal.label: Webhook URL
webhooks.reveal.title: URL for {name}
webhooks.reveal.warning: This URL will not be shown again. Copy it now; if you lose it, create a new URL.
webhooks.title: Incoming webhooks
